(3) harness composition.rs OutputPost: crop (negative expands transparent), bilinear resize on premultiplied values, channels rgb (straight or premultiplied) and alpha (grey matte); render_queue maps StudioOutputModule crop / resize / channels / color; rgb_alpha refused output_alpha_codec (no reel encoder carries alpha). Test: matte module cropped to 32x32 and resized to 16x16, decoded luma 235 inside / 16 below.

(4) motion blur per STU-MOT-004: Folio StudioCompositionMotionSettings (motion_records.composition_settings: master switch, shutter_angle 0..=720, shutter_phase -360..=360, samples_per_frame 2..=64, adaptive_sample_limit 2..=256, motion_blur_layers); render setting motion_blur current / on / off resolves it; FrameRenderer samples floor(start + width*(k+0.5)/n) inside [T + phase/360 tpf, T + (phase+angle)/360 tpf), checked layers from the sample scene, others from the frame scene, premultiplied average. Test motion_blur_samples_the_shutter_window_of_checked_layers: hand-computed alpha ramp 0, .25, .5, .75, 1 ... at offsets 1/3/5/7 px, the unchecked layer crisp, phase window formula, refusals.

(5) render once, encode many: SharedFrames (bounded cache, frames dropped after the last module, budget refused render_once_cache_budget before rendering, renders() counter); render_queue_jobs_shared / session_render_queue_jobs give every module of an item the same frames. Test: 5 frames rendered once for 2 modules (renders() == 5).
